sentences.text: Su vecino era un espía.
sentences.translation: His neighbour was a spy.

sentences.text: En esta novela, todos son espías.
sentences.translation: In this novel, everyone is a spy.

sentences.text: ¿Crees que ella es una espía?
sentences.translation: Do you think she's a spy?

sentences.text: La empresa tiene cincuenta empleados.
sentences.translation: The company has fifty employees.

sentences.text: Pregúntale al empleado de la tienda.
sentences.translation: Ask the shop worker.

sentences.text: Mi tía trabajó treinta años como empleada de banco.
sentences.translation: My aunt worked as a bank clerk for thirty years.

notes: Cream for coffee or cakes is nata in Spain.

sentences.text: Me pongo crema en las manos cada noche.
sentences.translation: I put cream on my hands every night.

sentences.text: De primero hay crema de verduras.
sentences.translation: For the first course there's cream of vegetable soup.

sentences.text: Mi hermana tiene muchas cremas en el baño.
sentences.translation: My sister has lots of creams in the bathroom.

sentences.text: ¿Por qué no me contestas?
sentences.translation: Why aren't you answering me?

sentences.text: Contesté todas las preguntas del examen.
sentences.translation: I answered all the questions on the exam.

sentences.text: Contesta en español, por favor.
sentences.translation: Answer in Spanish, please.

gloss: to send; to order, to be in charge

sentences.text: ¿Me mandas la dirección?
sentences.translation: Can you send me the address?

sentences.text: Aquí mando yo.
sentences.translation: I'm the one in charge here.

sentences.text: ¿Quién te ha mandado hacer eso?
sentences.translation: Who told you to do that?

sentences.text: Mi tía me mandó un paquete por mi cumpleaños.
sentences.translation: My aunt sent me a parcel for my birthday.

notes: Someone in jail is usually a preso; prisionero is mostly for war.

sentences.text: Los prisioneros volvieron a casa después de la guerra.
sentences.translation: The prisoners came home after the war.

sentences.text: Lo tuvieron prisionero en una isla.
sentences.translation: They held him prisoner on an island.

sentences.text: Me siento prisionera en mi propia casa.
sentences.translation: I feel like a prisoner in my own home.

sentences.text: La flota salió del puerto por la mañana.
sentences.translation: The fleet left the port in the morning.

sentences.text: La empresa tiene una flota de cien camiones.
sentences.translation: The company has a fleet of a hundred trucks.

sentences.text: Los dos países tienen flotas enormes.
sentences.translation: Both countries have huge fleets.

gloss: to commit (a crime); to make (a mistake)
notes: cometer un error = to make a mistake.

sentences.text: Ha cometido el mismo error dos veces.
sentences.translation: He's made the same mistake twice.

sentences.text: No cometió ningún crimen.
sentences.translation: He didn't commit any crime.

sentences.text: Cometí el error de confiar en él.
sentences.translation: I made the mistake of trusting him.

sentences.text: Gracias, igualmente.
sentences.translation: Thanks, same to you.

sentences.text: Los dos son igualmente importantes.
sentences.translation: They're both equally important.

sentences.text: No me apetece, pero iré igualmente.
sentences.translation: I don't feel like it, but I'll go anyway.

sentences.text: Hoy eres mi ayudante en la cocina.
sentences.translation: Today you're my helper in the kitchen.

sentences.text: El mecánico vino con su ayudante.
sentences.translation: The mechanic came with his assistant.

sentences.text: Necesitamos dos ayudantes más para la fiesta.
sentences.translation: We need two more helpers for the party.

sentences.text: La música es una parte importante de nuestra cultura.
sentences.translation: Music is an important part of our culture.

sentences.text: Cada país tiene su propia cultura.
sentences.translation: Every country has its own culture.

sentences.text: Viajar te ayuda a entender otras culturas.
sentences.translation: Travelling helps you understand other cultures.

sentences.text: La revolución empezó en la capital.
sentences.translation: The revolution started in the capital.

sentences.text: Internet fue una revolución.
sentences.translation: The internet was a revolution.

sentences.text: El país ha vivido dos revoluciones.
sentences.translation: The country has been through two revolutions.

sentences.text: Llevaba la mochila en un solo hombro.
sentences.translation: She carried her backpack on one shoulder.

sentences.text: Mi padre me llevaba sobre los hombros.
sentences.translation: My father used to carry me on his shoulders.

sentences.text: Puedes llorar en mi hombro.
sentences.translation: You can cry on my shoulder.

sentences.text: Necesito unas botas para la nieve.
sentences.translation: I need some snow boots.

sentences.text: Se me ha roto una bota.
sentences.translation: One of my boots has broken.

sentences.text: ¿Te gustan mis botas nuevas?
sentences.translation: Do you like my new boots?

sentences.text: Adoro este pueblo.
sentences.translation: I adore this town.

sentences.text: Los niños adoran a su abuela.
sentences.translation: The children adore their grandmother.

sentences.text: Mi madre adoraba el mar.
sentences.translation: My mother loved the sea.

sentences.text: Mi madre te manda saludos.
sentences.translation: My mother says hello.

sentences.text: Un saludo, Ana.
sentences.translation: Best wishes, Ana.

sentences.text: Me hizo un saludo con la mano.
sentences.translation: He waved hello to me.

sentences.text: Los adultos pagan diez euros y los niños, cinco.
sentences.translation: Adults pay ten euros and children five.

sentences.text: Ahora que eres adulta, decides tú.
sentences.translation: Now that you're an adult, you decide.

sentences.text: Los adultos también tienen miedo.
sentences.translation: Adults get scared too.

sentences.text: Vimos una serpiente en el camino.
sentences.translation: We saw a snake on the path.

sentences.text: Las serpientes me dan mucho asco.
sentences.translation: I find snakes really disgusting.

sentences.text: Tranquilo, esa serpiente no es peligrosa.
sentences.translation: Don't worry, that snake isn't dangerous.

sentences.text: Fue una cena muy romántica.
sentences.translation: It was a very romantic dinner.

sentences.text: Mi marido no es nada romántico.
sentences.translation: My husband isn't romantic at all.

sentences.text: Nunca veo películas románticas.
sentences.translation: I never watch romantic films.

sentences.text: Es posiblemente la película más larga que he visto.
sentences.translation: It's possibly the longest film I've seen.

sentences.text: Posiblemente, pero no lo sé seguro.
sentences.translation: Possibly, but I don't know for sure.

sentences.text: Posiblemente vengan mis padres.
sentences.translation: My parents might come.

notes: enfrente de = opposite.

sentences.text: Siéntate enfrente de mí.
sentences.translation: Sit opposite me.

sentences.text: Hay un bar enfrente del colegio.
sentences.translation: There's a bar opposite the school.

sentences.text: Los vecinos de enfrente tienen un perro.
sentences.translation: The neighbours across the street have a dog.

sentences.text: Tiene una gran capacidad para aprender.
sentences.translation: She has a great ability to learn.

sentences.text: El estadio tiene capacidad para cincuenta mil personas.
sentences.translation: The stadium holds fifty thousand people.

sentences.text: No dudo de tus capacidades.
sentences.translation: I don't doubt your abilities.

sentences.text: Llegué arriba sin aliento.
sentences.translation: I got to the top out of breath.

sentences.text: Tu perro tiene mal aliento.
sentences.translation: Your dog has bad breath.

sentences.text: Gracias por tus palabras de aliento.
sentences.translation: Thanks for your words of encouragement.

sentences.text: El policía me enseñó su placa.
sentences.translation: The police officer showed me his badge.

sentences.text: En la puerta hay una placa con su nombre.
sentences.translation: On the door there's a plaque with his name.

sentences.text: En mi calle cambiaron todas las placas.
sentences.translation: They changed all the signs on my street.

notes: In Spain, ser una rata also means to be stingy.

sentences.text: ¡Esa rata es enorme!
sentences.translation: That rat is huge!

sentences.text: Anoche vi dos ratas en la calle.
sentences.translation: Last night I saw two rats in the street.

sentences.text: No seas rata y paga tú.
sentences.translation: Don't be stingy, you pay.

sentences.text: Mi abuela tiene un cuadro precioso en el salón.
sentences.translation: My grandmother has a beautiful painting in the living room.

sentences.text: ¿Quién ha pintado este cuadro?
sentences.translation: Who painted this picture?

sentences.text: Llevaba una camisa de cuadros.
sentences.translation: He was wearing a checked shirt.

sentences.text: Soy muy afortunado de tenerte.
sentences.translation: I'm very lucky to have you.

sentences.text: Te ha tocado la lotería, ¡qué afortunada!
sentences.translation: You've won the lottery, how lucky!

sentences.text: Nos sentimos afortunados de vivir aquí.
sentences.translation: We feel lucky to live here.

notes: Also a form of poner: he puesto = I have put.

sentences.text: Le han ofrecido un puesto en Madrid.
sentences.translation: They've offered him a job in Madrid.

sentences.text: En el mercado, los puestos de fruta abren temprano.
sentences.translation: At the market, the fruit stalls open early.

sentences.text: Ella tiene un puesto de mucha responsabilidad.
sentences.translation: She has a position with a lot of responsibility.

sentences.text: El equipo juega en primera división.
sentences.translation: The team plays in the first division.

sentences.text: Los niños ya saben hacer divisiones.
sentences.translation: The kids can already do division.

sentences.text: Hay mucha división dentro del partido.
sentences.translation: There's a lot of division within the party.

notes: People often say bici.

sentences.text: Mi bicicleta es vieja, pero funciona.
sentences.translation: My bike is old, but it works.

sentences.text: Dejamos las bicicletas en la puerta.
sentences.translation: We left the bikes at the door.

sentences.text: Prefiero ir en bicicleta, es más rápido.
sentences.translation: I prefer to go by bike, it's faster.

sentences.text: Esta maleta es muy pesada.
sentences.translation: This suitcase is very heavy.

sentences.text: No seas pesado, ya te he dicho que no.
sentences.translation: Don't be a pain, I've already told you no.

sentences.text: No debes llevar cosas pesadas.
sentences.translation: You shouldn't carry heavy things.

notes: e changes to ie or i: sugiero, sugirió.

sentences.text: Te sugiero que lo pienses bien.
sentences.translation: I suggest you think it over carefully.

sentences.text: ¿Qué sugieres?
sentences.translation: What do you suggest?

sentences.text: El médico me sugirió descansar más.
sentences.translation: The doctor suggested I rest more.

sentences.text: Quiere trabajar en una estación espacial.
sentences.translation: She wants to work on a space station.

sentences.text: De niño quería una nave espacial.
sentences.translation: As a kid I wanted a spaceship.

sentences.text: Las misiones espaciales son muy caras.
sentences.translation: Space missions are very expensive.

sentences.text: Las cosas van a mejorar.
sentences.translation: Things are going to get better.

sentences.text: El tiempo ha mejorado mucho.
sentences.translation: The weather has got much better.

sentences.text: Mi abuelo mejoró después de la operación.
sentences.translation: My grandfather got better after the surgery.

sentences.text: Ganó un concurso de cocina.
sentences.translation: She won a cooking contest.

sentences.text: Mi madre ve concursos en la tele.
sentences.translation: My mother watches game shows on TV.

sentences.text: Me voy a presentar al concurso de fotos.
sentences.translation: I'm going to enter the photo contest.

sentences.text: Al lado del hospital hay una comisaría.
sentences.translation: There's a police station next to the hospital.

sentences.text: ¿Dónde está la comisaría más cercana?
sentences.translation: Where's the nearest police station?

sentences.text: Llamaron a todas las comisarías de la zona.
sentences.translation: They called every police station in the area.

sentences.text: Te voy a ser sincero.
sentences.translation: I'll be honest with you.

sentences.text: Quiero una respuesta sincera.
sentences.translation: I want a sincere answer.

sentences.text: Prefiero a las personas sinceras.
sentences.translation: I prefer sincere people.

notes: In Latin America, centavo.

sentences.text: Me faltan veinte céntimos para el café.
sentences.translation: I'm twenty cents short for the coffee.

sentences.text: El pan ha subido diez céntimos.
sentences.translation: Bread has gone up ten cents.

sentences.text: No pienso pagar ni un céntimo más.
sentences.translation: I'm not paying a single cent more.

sentences.text: Naturalmente, te ayudaré.
sentences.translation: Naturally, I'll help you.

sentences.text: Mi hijo es naturalmente tranquilo.
sentences.translation: My son is naturally calm.

sentences.text: Le pedí dinero y, naturalmente, dijo que no.
sentences.translation: I asked him for money and, naturally, he said no.

sentences.text: Es un país con pocos recursos.
sentences.translation: It's a country with few resources.

sentences.text: No tenemos recursos para eso.
sentences.translation: We don't have the resources for that.

sentences.text: Era mi último recurso.
sentences.translation: It was my last resort.

sentences.text: Quiero un perro, pero no me importa la raza.
sentences.translation: I want a dog, but I don't care about the breed.

sentences.text: En mi barrio vive gente de todas las razas.
sentences.translation: People of every race live in my neighbourhood.

sentences.text: Esta raza de caballo es muy antigua.
sentences.translation: This breed of horse is very old.

notes: Also a form of mostrar: me muestra = shows me.

sentences.text: Necesitamos una muestra de sangre.
sentences.translation: We need a blood sample.

sentences.text: Me dieron muestras gratis de perfume.
sentences.translation: They gave me free perfume samples.

sentences.text: Este regalo es una muestra de cariño.
sentences.translation: This present is a sign of affection.

sentences.text: Tienes mucha imaginación.
sentences.translation: You have a lot of imagination.

sentences.text: Son cosas de tu imaginación.
sentences.translation: It's all in your imagination.

sentences.text: Para los regalos no tengo imaginación.
sentences.translation: I'm not very imaginative when it comes to presents.

sentences.text: Mi hermano no vino a la ceremonia.
sentences.translation: My brother didn't come to the ceremony.

sentences.text: Nos casamos en una ceremonia muy sencilla.
sentences.translation: We got married in a very simple ceremony.

sentences.text: En verano hay muchas ceremonias en esta iglesia.
sentences.translation: In summer there are lots of ceremonies in this church.

sentences.text: Trabajo en un almacén de muebles.
sentences.translation: I work at a furniture warehouse.

sentences.text: Las cajas están en el almacén.
sentences.translation: The boxes are in the storeroom.

sentences.text: Vamos de compras a los grandes almacenes.
sentences.translation: Let's go shopping at the department store.

sentences.text: Esta sopa no tiene sabor.
sentences.translation: This soup has no taste.

sentences.text: Elige el sabor de helado que quieras.
sentences.translation: Choose whichever ice cream flavour you want.

sentences.text: Me encantan los sabores de la cocina india.
sentences.translation: I love the flavours of Indian cooking.

sentences.text: La unión hace la fuerza.
sentences.translation: Unity is strength.

sentences.text: España es parte de la Unión Europea.
sentences.translation: Spain is part of the European Union.

sentences.text: Hay mucha unión entre los hermanos.
sentences.translation: The brothers and sisters are very close.

sentences.text: He hecho una reserva para las nueve.
sentences.translation: I've made a booking for nine o'clock.

sentences.text: Quiero cancelar mi reserva.
sentences.translation: I want to cancel my booking.

sentences.text: Quedan pocas reservas de agua.
sentences.translation: There are few water reserves left.

sentences.text: Este pueblo tiene mucho encanto.
sentences.translation: This village has a lot of charm.

sentences.text: Tu abuela es un encanto.
sentences.translation: Your grandmother is a delight.

sentences.text: Cada estación tiene sus encantos.
sentences.translation: Every season has its charms.

sentences.text: Es un producto de buena calidad.
sentences.translation: It's a good quality product.

sentences.text: Prefiero la calidad a la cantidad.
sentences.translation: I prefer quality to quantity.

sentences.text: La calidad del aire es mala hoy.
sentences.translation: The air quality is bad today.

sentences.text: ¿Dónde escondes las llaves?
sentences.translation: Where do you hide the keys?

sentences.text: El niño se escondió debajo de la cama.
sentences.translation: The child hid under the bed.

sentences.text: Has escondido mis zapatos, ¿verdad?
sentences.translation: You've hidden my shoes, haven't you?

sentences.text: ¡Escóndete, que viene!
sentences.translation: Hide, he's coming!

sentences.text: Echa un poco de aceite a la ensalada.
sentences.translation: Put a little oil on the salad.

sentences.text: Mezcla los dos aceites.
sentences.translation: Mix the two oils.

sentences.text: El coche pierde aceite.
sentences.translation: The car is leaking oil.

sentences.text: Lo tengo en la punta de la lengua.
sentences.translation: It's on the tip of my tongue.

sentences.text: Vive en la otra punta de la ciudad.
sentences.translation: She lives at the other end of town.

sentences.text: Toca las puntas de los pies.
sentences.translation: Touch your toes.

sentences.text: En el coche, siempre llevo el cinturón.
sentences.translation: In the car, I always wear my seatbelt.

sentences.text: Necesito un cinturón para estos pantalones.
sentences.translation: I need a belt for these trousers.

sentences.text: Estos cinturones son de cuero.
sentences.translation: These belts are leather.

notes: A chiste is a joke you tell; a broma is a joke you play or make.

sentences.text: Cuéntame un chiste.
sentences.translation: Tell me a joke.

sentences.text: Mi padre cuenta chistes muy malos.
sentences.translation: My dad tells really bad jokes.

sentences.text: No entendí el chiste.
sentences.translation: I didn't get the joke.

sentences.text: Todo tiene consecuencias.
sentences.translation: Everything has consequences.

sentences.text: Tendrás que aceptar las consecuencias.
sentences.translation: You'll have to accept the consequences.

sentences.text: Como consecuencia, perdió el trabajo.
sentences.translation: As a consequence, he lost his job.

notes: Honestamente means the same.

sentences.text: Espero sinceramente que te vaya bien.
sentences.translation: I sincerely hope things go well for you.

sentences.text: Te lo agradezco sinceramente.
sentences.translation: I'm truly grateful to you.

sentences.text: ¿Sinceramente? Me parece caro.
sentences.translation: Honestly? I think it's expensive.

sentences.text: Vimos vacas desde el tren.
sentences.translation: We saw cows from the train.

sentences.text: La leche de vaca no me sienta bien.
sentences.translation: Cow's milk doesn't agree with me.

sentences.text: La vaca se comió las flores del jardín.
sentences.translation: The cow ate the flowers in the garden.

sentences.text: Mi hermana investiga el cáncer.
sentences.translation: My sister does cancer research.

sentences.text: ¿Quién está investigando el accidente?
sentences.translation: Who's investigating the accident?

sentences.text: Nadie investigó su muerte.
sentences.translation: Nobody investigated his death.

sentences.text: Tengo el apellido de mi madre.
sentences.translation: I have my mother's surname.

sentences.text: En España tenemos dos apellidos.
sentences.translation: In Spain we have two surnames.

sentences.text: No sé cómo se escribe tu apellido.
sentences.translation: I don't know how to spell your surname.

notes: False friend: actual means current, not real.

sentences.text: Estoy contento con mi trabajo actual.
sentences.translation: I'm happy with my current job.

sentences.text: La situación actual es difícil.
sentences.translation: The current situation is difficult.

sentences.text: Las casas actuales son más pequeñas.
sentences.translation: Today's houses are smaller.

notes: Momento means almost the same; an instante is a very short moment.

sentences.text: En ese instante sonó el teléfono.
sentences.translation: At that instant, the phone rang.

sentences.text: Al instante supe que era ella.
sentences.translation: I knew instantly that it was her.

sentences.text: Durante un instante, nadie dijo nada.
sentences.translation: For an instant, nobody said anything.

sentences.text: No puede controlar sus emociones.
sentences.translation: He can't control his emotions.

sentences.text: Los niños esperan la Navidad con emoción.
sentences.translation: The children are waiting for Christmas with excitement.

sentences.text: Con la emoción, se me olvidó tu regalo.
sentences.translation: In all the excitement, I forgot your present.

notes: In everyday speech people often say habitación or cuarto.

sentences.text: Los dormitorios dan al jardín.
sentences.translation: The bedrooms look out onto the garden.

sentences.text: El dormitorio de mis padres es el más grande.
sentences.translation: My parents' bedroom is the biggest.

sentences.text: Los niños duermen en el mismo dormitorio.
sentences.translation: The kids sleep in the same bedroom.

sentences.text: Tiene el pulso muy débil.
sentences.translation: His pulse is very weak.

sentences.text: No le encuentro el pulso.
sentences.translation: I can't find his pulse.

sentences.text: Tengo buen pulso para dibujar.
sentences.translation: I have a steady hand for drawing.

notes: Always used as atreverse: me atrevo, te atreves.

sentences.text: Mi hermano pequeño no se atreve a saltar.
sentences.translation: My little brother doesn't dare to jump.

sentences.text: Todavía no me atrevo a decírselo.
sentences.translation: I still don't dare tell him.

sentences.text: Nadie se atrevió a hablar.
sentences.translation: Nobody dared to speak.

sentences.text: ¿Cómo te atreves a hablarme así?
sentences.translation: How dare you speak to me like that?

sentences.text: Repite la frase, por favor.
sentences.translation: Repeat the sentence, please.

sentences.text: Escribe tres frases con esta palabra.
sentences.translation: Write three sentences with this word.

sentences.text: Mi abuelo siempre dice esa frase.
sentences.translation: My grandfather always says that phrase.

notes: A football match is a partido, not a partida.

sentences.text: ¿Echamos una partida de cartas?
sentences.translation: Shall we play a game of cards?

sentences.text: Hemos jugado tres partidas y he ganado dos.
sentences.translation: We've played three rounds and I've won two.

sentences.text: Esto es solo el punto de partida.
sentences.translation: This is just the starting point.

gloss: to fire; to see off; (despedirse) to say goodbye
notes: e changes to i in some forms: despido, despidieron.

sentences.text: Me han despedido del trabajo.
sentences.translation: I've been fired from my job.

sentences.text: Fuimos al aeropuerto a despedirla.
sentences.translation: We went to the airport to see her off.

sentences.text: Nos despedimos en la puerta de casa.
sentences.translation: We said goodbye at the front door.

sentences.text: Despídete de tus amigos, nos vamos.
sentences.translation: Say goodbye to your friends, we're leaving.

sentences.text: Tengo la obligación moral de ayudarle.
sentences.translation: I have a moral duty to help him.

sentences.text: Le dimos apoyo moral.
sentences.translation: We gave him moral support.

sentences.text: Tiene principios morales muy fuertes.
sentences.translation: He has very strong moral principles.

sentences.text: El asalto a la ciudad duró tres días.
sentences.translation: The assault on the city lasted three days.

sentences.text: Ganó el combate en el tercer asalto.
sentences.translation: He won the fight in the third round.

sentences.text: Fue un combate de doce asaltos.
sentences.translation: It was a twelve-round fight.

sentences.text: Busco un trabajo con un sueldo decente.
sentences.translation: I'm looking for a job with a decent salary.

sentences.text: Ponte algo decente, que vamos a cenar fuera.
sentences.translation: Put on something decent, we're eating out.

sentences.text: Aquí no hay hoteles decentes.
sentences.translation: There are no decent hotels here.

notes: asustarse = to get scared: me asusté = I got scared.

sentences.text: Me asusta conducir de noche.
sentences.translation: Driving at night scares me.

sentences.text: El ruido asustó a los niños.
sentences.translation: The noise frightened the children.

sentences.text: ¡Qué susto! No me asustes así.
sentences.translation: What a fright! Don't scare me like that.

notes: For a car, people usually say gasolina.

sentences.text: Nos estamos quedando sin combustible.
sentences.translation: We're running out of fuel.

sentences.text: El precio del combustible ha subido.
sentences.translation: The price of fuel has gone up.

sentences.text: El avión necesita más combustible.
sentences.translation: The plane needs more fuel.

notes: Usually it means an argument, not a calm talk.

sentences.text: Tuvimos una discusión muy fuerte.
sentences.translation: We had a big argument.

sentences.text: En las comidas familiares siempre hay discusiones.
sentences.translation: There are always arguments at family meals.

sentences.text: Después de la charla hubo una discusión interesante.
sentences.translation: After the talk there was an interesting discussion.

gloss: leg, paw (of an animal or furniture)
notes: Pierna is for people; pata is for animals and furniture.

sentences.text: Me he dado un golpe con la pata de la cama.
sentences.translation: I banged myself on the leg of the bed.

sentences.text: Los perros tienen cuatro patas.
sentences.translation: Dogs have four legs.

sentences.text: El gato tiene una pata blanca.
sentences.translation: The cat has one white paw.

notes: e changes to ie in some forms: requiere.

sentences.text: Este trabajo requiere mucha paciencia.
sentences.translation: This job requires a lot of patience.

sentences.text: ¿Qué documentos se requieren?
sentences.translation: What documents are required?

sentences.text: El viaje requería mucha preparación.
sentences.translation: The trip required a lot of preparation.

sentences.text: En una pareja, la comunicación es muy importante.
sentences.translation: In a relationship, communication is very important.

sentences.text: Hay problemas de comunicación entre los dos equipos.
sentences.translation: There are communication problems between the two teams.

sentences.text: Las comunicaciones con la isla son difíciles.
sentences.translation: Communications with the island are difficult.

notes: tener sed = to be thirsty.

sentences.text: Bebe agua antes de tener sed.
sentences.translation: Drink water before you get thirsty.

sentences.text: Correr me da sed.
sentences.translation: Running makes me thirsty.

sentences.text: Los perros tenían sed después del paseo.
sentences.translation: The dogs were thirsty after the walk.

gloss: jewel, piece of jewellery; gem (a great person)

sentences.text: Le robaron todas sus joyas.
sentences.translation: They stole all her jewellery.

sentences.text: Este anillo es la única joya que tengo.
sentences.translation: This ring is the only piece of jewellery I have.

sentences.text: Tu hijo es una joya.
sentences.translation: Your son is a gem.

sentences.text: Lo hizo por una causa noble.
sentences.translation: He did it for a noble cause.

sentences.text: Viene de una familia noble.
sentences.translation: She comes from a noble family.

sentences.text: Los caballos son animales nobles.
sentences.translation: Horses are good-natured animals.

sentences.text: Lo llamaron traidor por irse al otro equipo.
sentences.translation: They called him a traitor for joining the other team.

sentences.text: En la película, el traidor es su mejor amigo.
sentences.translation: In the film, the traitor is his best friend.

sentences.text: Nadie quiere a los traidores.
sentences.translation: Nobody likes traitors.

notes: A letter you send is a carta.

sentences.text: La palabra tiene cinco letras.
sentences.translation: The word has five letters.

sentences.text: No entiendo tu letra.
sentences.translation: I can't read your handwriting.

sentences.text: ¿Te sabes la letra de esta canción?
sentences.translation: Do you know the lyrics of this song?

sentences.text: El tren sale por la vía dos.
sentences.translation: The train leaves from track two.

sentences.text: Hay un gato en las vías.
sentences.translation: There's a cat on the tracks.

sentences.text: Está prohibido cruzar la vía.
sentences.translation: It's forbidden to cross the railway track.

notes: In everyday Spanish, a priest is usually a cura.

sentences.text: El sacerdote los casó en la iglesia.
sentences.translation: The priest married them in the church.

sentences.text: Mi tío quería ser sacerdote.
sentences.translation: My uncle wanted to be a priest.

sentences.text: Los sacerdotes vivían en el templo.
sentences.translation: The priests lived in the temple.

sentences.text: Tiene mucha resistencia: corre veinte kilómetros.
sentences.translation: She has a lot of stamina: she runs twenty kilometres.

sentences.text: El ejército encontró poca resistencia.
sentences.translation: The army met little resistance.

sentences.text: Mi abuelo luchó en la resistencia.
sentences.translation: My grandfather fought in the resistance.

sentences.text: En Valencia se come mucho arroz.
sentences.translation: In Valencia people eat a lot of rice.

sentences.text: El arroz necesita veinte minutos.
sentences.translation: The rice needs twenty minutes.

sentences.text: El arroz se ha quemado.
sentences.translation: The rice has burnt.

notes: un desconocido = a stranger.

sentences.text: Me ha llamado un número desconocido.
sentences.translation: I've had a call from an unknown number.

sentences.text: Los motivos todavía son desconocidos.
sentences.translation: The reasons are still unknown.

sentences.text: No abras la puerta a gente desconocida.
sentences.translation: Don't open the door to people you don't know.

notes: como mínimo = at least.

sentences.text: El salario mínimo ha subido este año.
sentences.translation: The minimum wage has gone up this year.

sentences.text: No tengo la más mínima idea.
sentences.translation: I haven't the slightest idea.

sentences.text: Los cambios son mínimos.
sentences.translation: The changes are minimal.

sentences.text: España tiene una bandera roja y amarilla.
sentences.translation: Spain has a red and yellow flag.

sentences.text: Había banderas en todas las ventanas.
sentences.translation: There were flags in every window.

sentences.text: ¿De qué país es esta bandera?
sentences.translation: Which country is this flag from?

gloss: square; place (at a university, on a course)

sentences.text: Nos vemos en la plaza mayor.
sentences.translation: See you in the main square.

sentences.text: Me han dado una plaza en la universidad.
sentences.translation: I've got a place at university.

sentences.text: En el centro hay varias plazas con fuentes.
sentences.translation: In the centre there are several squares with fountains.

sentences.text: Planeamos ir a la playa en agosto.
sentences.translation: We're planning to go to the beach in August.

sentences.text: ¿Qué estás planeando?
sentences.translation: What are you planning?

sentences.text: Lo tenían todo planeado.
sentences.translation: They had it all planned.

sentences.text: El Imperio romano era enorme.
sentences.translation: The Roman Empire was huge.

sentences.text: Construyó un imperio con sus hoteles.
sentences.translation: He built an empire with his hotels.

sentences.text: Tarde o temprano, todos los imperios caen.
sentences.translation: Sooner or later, all empires fall.

sentences.text: No llevo dinero en la cartera.
sentences.translation: I don't have any money in my wallet.

sentences.text: Llevo la cartera en el bolsillo de atrás.
sentences.translation: I keep my wallet in my back pocket.

sentences.text: Los niños van al colegio con sus carteras.
sentences.translation: The kids go to school with their school bags.

sentences.text: Llena el depósito, por favor.
sentences.translation: Fill up the tank, please.

sentences.text: Hay que pagar un depósito de cien euros.
sentences.translation: You have to pay a hundred-euro deposit.

sentences.text: En el tejado hay dos depósitos de agua.
sentences.translation: There are two water tanks on the roof.

sentences.text: De mayor quiero ser periodista.
sentences.translation: When I grow up I want to be a journalist.

sentences.text: Había muchos periodistas en la puerta.
sentences.translation: There were many journalists at the door.

sentences.text: El periodista me hizo muchas preguntas.
sentences.translation: The journalist asked me a lot of questions.

notes: o changes to ue in some forms: compruebo.

sentences.text: Comprueba que el gas está apagado.
sentences.translation: Make sure the gas is off.

sentences.text: El inspector comprobó su historia.
sentences.translation: The inspector verified his story.

sentences.text: Compruébalo tú mismo.
sentences.translation: See for yourself.

notes: el forense = the medical examiner.

sentences.text: El médico forense llegó a las diez.
sentences.translation: The medical examiner arrived at ten.

sentences.text: Esperamos el informe forense.
sentences.translation: We're waiting for the forensic report.

sentences.text: Los equipos forenses ya están en la casa.
sentences.translation: The forensic teams are already at the house.

sentences.text: Había mucha tensión en la reunión.
sentences.translation: There was a lot of tension in the meeting.

sentences.text: Con la edad, sube la tensión.
sentences.translation: Blood pressure goes up with age.

sentences.text: Hay tensiones entre los dos países.
sentences.translation: There are tensions between the two countries.

sentences.text: No quiero estar involucrado en esto.
sentences.translation: I don't want to be involved in this.

sentences.text: ¿Está tu hermana involucrada?
sentences.translation: Is your sister involved?

sentences.text: Tres coches estuvieron involucrados en el accidente.
sentences.translation: Three cars were involved in the accident.
